purpose: Requirements for document search: finding task-relevant documents without omissions, checking whether the ToC needs rebuilding before search, and the information search results must contain.
summary: FR-006 document search returning documents relevant to a given task
Recall priority: borderline documents are included and the requester decides what to read
Search uses the ToC for the given key, or the reserved key all when omitted
Missing ToC returns a notice that an initial build is required
Pre-search check decides whether rebuild is needed; user chooses rebuild or search the existing ToC
Confirmation writes a target specification file and returns its path, so the rebuild targets the same set
Confirmation shows rebuild scale counts and summary-generation count; details go to a work file
Failure to judge rebuild necessity stops the search and no stale-ToC option is offered
Searching the stale ToC notifies that results may not reflect current documents
Result contents and acceptance criterion AC-019
tasks: Designing the pre-search ToC rebuild check
Implementing target specification file output for search confirmation
Defining search result fields and ToC state reporting
Writing tests for search acceptance criterion AC-019
